title: The Assistant Persona Differs Across Languages in Activation Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.27504v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models behave differently across languages, and are noticeably less safe in lower-resource languages. This gap is well established behaviorally, but not mechanistically. Directions in activation space, including the assistant persona direction, are almost always extracted from English and assumed to generalize across languages. We extract the assistant persona direction in 31 languages in Qwen3-32B, and find that the resulting axes differ substantially: their cosine similarity to the English axis ranges from 0.378 to 0.911. Moreover, each language's assistant persona direction and its magnitude are correlated with the language's resource level. We also find that the model's default assistant state is farther from the helpful assistant pole in lower-resource languages. translated_title: 助手人格在激活空间中因语言而异
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在不同语言之间的行为存在差异，且在低资源语言中明显不够安全。这一差距在行为层面已被充分证实，但在机制层面尚未得到解释。激活空间中的方向，包括助手人格方向，几乎总是从英语中提取并被假定可以跨语言泛化。我们在 Qwen3-32B 中提取了31种语言的助手人格方向，发现所得的轴存在显著差异：它们与英语轴的余弦相似度介于0.378到0.911之间。此外，每种语言的助手人格方向及其幅值都与该语言的资源水平相关。我们还发现，模型的默认助手状态在低资源语言中距离“乐于助人的助手”这一极点更远。最后，相较于沿英语轴进行干预（steering），沿语言自身的轴进行干预会更强烈地放大基于人格的越狱攻击。这些结果表明……
tldr: 该研究首次从机制层面揭示了大语言模型中助手人格方向在不同语言间差异显著（与英语轴余弦相似度仅0.378–0.911）且与语言资源水平相关，证明从英语提取的激活方向无法跨语言泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first mechanistic evidence that the assistant persona direction in activation space differs substantially across 31 languages in Qwen3-32B—correlated with language resource level—showing that English-extracted activation directions do not generalize across languages.
